title: Thorn-Reflection Scribe
text: Thorn-Reflection Scribe records each doubt in mirrored ink until the expedition begins reading its own fear aloud. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The contract signs itself in the reader's hand.

defeatReward.text: Thorn-Reflection Scribe is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
